title: Bacteriophages of Gordonia spp. Display a Spectrum of Diversity and Genetic Relationships
key_verified_evidence: 79 Gordonia phages; 14 clusters and 14 singletons; variable lysis organization and frequent LysB displacement already described.
scope_limit: Genomic inference does not validate every annotated lysis protein or identify rearrangement direction.
sequence_or_gene_ids: KU963248 (Yvonnetastic); see original Table 1 for cohort

title: Bioinformatic characterization of endolysins and holin-like membrane proteins in the lysis cassette of phages that infect Gordonia rubripertincta
key_verified_evidence: 77 phages represented by 16 cassette organizations; LysA flanking phams and holin-like membrane candidates evaluated; distal LysB genes examined.
scope_limit: Holin-like labels and structural matches are predictions; proximity was used in identification, creating potential circularity for new synteny tests.

title: Decoding Viral Dark Matter: Metagenomic Prokaryotic Virus Characterization With Pharokka, Phold, and Phynteny
key_verified_evidence: Published 7 July 2026; sequence, structural and synteny annotation workflows; Phold database requires at least 15 GB storage.
scope_limit: Methods paper does not establish actinophage lysis function; Phold is not used for primary functional assignments; synteny-based labels cannot independently validate synteny.

title: Genome Sequence of Gordonia Phage Yvonnetastic
key_verified_evidence: Published 7 July 2016; 98136 bp; predicted lysis region amid minor tail genes and putative LysB more than 50 kb away.
scope_limit: Architecture positive control only; no biochemical demonstration of the putative LysB; gene IDs must be mapped to the frozen record.

title: Mycobacteriophage Lysin B is a novel mycolylarabinogalactan esterase
key_verified_evidence: D29 LysB characterized structurally and biochemically; Giles lysB deletion assessed phage release.
scope_limit: Separate D29 enzyme assays from Giles deletion evidence; activity is not established for every homolog.

title: The lytic cassette of mycobacteriophage Ms6 encodes an enzyme with lipolytic activity
key_verified_evidence: Ms6 LysB encoded between lysA and holin shows lipolytic activity.
scope_limit: Generic esterase activity alone is not the complete substrate-specific definition of LysB.

title: Mycobacteriophage Ms6 LysB specifically targets the outer membrane of Mycobacterium smegmatis
key_verified_evidence: Ms6 LysB hydrolyzes mycolates in mAGP and other envelope lipids.
scope_limit: Substrate-specific evidence is direct for this protein and tested substrates; not proof of identical homolog activity.

title: The mycobacteriophage Ms6 encodes a chaperone-like protein involved in the endolysin delivery to the peptidoglycan
key_verified_evidence: Ms6 Gp1 assists delivery of LysA to peptidoglycan.
scope_limit: Do not assign chaperone function to every adjacent hypothetical protein.

title: Functional Analysis of the Holin-Like Proteins of Mycobacteriophage Ms6
key_verified_evidence: Ms6 gp4 and gp5 deletions change lysis timing; interactions tested; Fig1 identifies Gp4 accession AAG48320.
scope_limit: Nonessential in the tested background; two transmembrane helices alone do not establish holin activity.
sequence_or_gene_ids: AF319619;Ms6 gp4;AAG48320;Ms6 gp5 (protein ID unresolved in literature inspection)

title: A Second Endolysin Gene Is Fully Embedded In-Frame with the lysA Gene of Mycobacteriophage Ms6
key_verified_evidence: Ms6 gp2 produces 384-aa and 241-aa forms; targeted mutations alter lysis; FigS2 identifies AAG48318; lysis locus AF319619.
scope_limit: Nested translation product is not a second genomic CDS; do not infer independent gene duplication.

title: The Endolysin-Binding Domain Encompasses the N-Terminal Region of the Mycobacteriophage Ms6 Gp1 Chaperone
key_verified_evidence: Fig2B identifies Ms6 Gp1 accession AAG48317; domain and oligomerization experiments.
scope_limit: Chaperone interaction is demonstrated for Ms6; related sequence families remain inferred homologs.

title: Mycobacteriophage Endolysins: Diverse and Modular Enzymes with Multiple Catalytic Activities
key_verified_evidence: 25 LysA domain arrangements; discordant domain relationships; selected expression and lytic assays include D29 gp10.
scope_limit: Not every protein or domain activity was experimentally validated; domain mosaicism complicates full-length protein trees.

title: Functional requirements for bacteriophage growth: gene essentiality and expression in mycobacteriophage Giles
key_verified_evidence: Functional dissection of Giles establishes gene essentiality and expression patterns.
scope_limit: Essentiality is condition and background dependent; transfer by homology remains an inference.
sequence_or_gene_ids: Giles; genome and proteins to be frozen from source record

title: Mycobacteriophage D29 holin C-terminal region functionally assists in holin aggregation and bacterial cell death
key_verified_evidence: D29 gp11 characterized by expression effects, aggregation and C-terminal function.
scope_limit: Protein function supported for D29 gp11; topology does not validate all membrane proteins.

title: The Ms6 Mycolyl-Arabinogalactan Esterase LysB is Essential for an Efficient Mycobacteriophage-Induced Lysis
key_verified_evidence: Ms6 lysB deletion is viable but virion release is impaired; AF319619 listed for Ms6.
scope_limit: The title's efficient lysis qualification matters: LysB was not absolutely essential for viability in the experiment.

title: Isolating and characterizing cluster AB Mycobacteriophage NoShow, which encodes lysis proteins shared with cluster H2 phages
key_verified_evidence: Cluster AB genome has lysis genes most similar to cluster H2 phages.
scope_limit: A cross-cluster similarity pattern is not by itself proof of an independent rearrangement or a biochemical function.

title: Genome Sequence of Gordonia rubripertincta Phage DoobyDoo of the DV Cluster
key_verified_evidence: Published 15 March 2025; putative LysA gene35 central and LysB gene86 terminal.
scope_limit: Predicted lysis functions; useful displaced-architecture control, not a characterized protein reference.

title: Synteny-aware functional annotation of bacteriophage genomes with Phynteny
key_verified_evidence: Uses genomic context and protein representations for broad functional categories.
scope_limit: Preprint status at inspected source; synteny-driven lysis predictions are not independent functional evidence for a synteny test.

title: Exploring the molecular properties and bactericidal potential of Lysin B from mycobacteriophage WXIN
key_verified_evidence: Published 16 January 2026; WPH57662 assayed; Ser96-Asp191-His268 mutagenesis supports esterase activity.
scope_limit: Antimycobacterial assay used Tween80; native infection requirement and exact mAGP substrate specificity are not established by generic ester substrate assays.

title: Concentration-dependent dual activity of a phage-encoded lysin modulates infection dynamics in mycobacteriophage D29
key_verified_evidence: Published online 13 July 2026; LysB deletion and exogenous treatment reveal stage and concentration-dependent effects.
scope_limit: Authors restrict interpretation to D29; no generalization to every LysB or assertion of evolved regulation.

title: Genome Structure of Mycobacteriophage D29: Implications for Phage Evolution
key_verified_evidence: D29 gp17 identified by amino-terminal sequencing of virion protein band C; supports structural specificity control.
scope_limit: Structural evidence is not experimental proof that the protein has no secondary function; no lysis label is propagated.

title: Anti-mycobacterial activity of phage-encoded lysterases
key_verified_evidence: Published 13 October 2026; Table 1 identifies six assayed proteins; five add reference diversity and D29 is an existing sequence alias.
scope_limit: Killing by purified reference proteins does not independently establish native mycolate-substrate cleavage or a requirement during infection; capped moderate homology tier.

title: Functional characterization of endolysins derived from mycobacteriophage RitSun as effective antimycobacterial agents
key_verified_evidence: Reports recombinant RitSun LysA and LysB, antimycobacterial assays, lysozyme activity for LysA and esterase activity for LysB.
scope_limit: Conference abstract only; methods and data are limited, and no tested LysA protein accession or construct sequence is stated. The later full article characterizes RitSun LysB only.

title: Genomic and Functional Analyses of Rhodococcus equi Phages ReqiPepy6, ReqiPoco6, ReqiPine5, and ReqiDocB7
key_verified_evidence: Maps proposed LysB candidates to Pepy6 gp33 and Poco6 gp34 in structural region, and possible DocB7 gp38; all lie 10-22 CDS after putative LysA; none meets the existing LysB reference assignment identity/coverage cutoff.
scope_limit: Sequence relationships and whole-phage host effects do not establish candidate-protein function; no protein-specific assay, deletion or rescue for these candidates is reported.
